name: Jellyfin
description: Connect to your personal Jellyfin media server to sync your movie and TV libraries into Otix, and stream media directly inside the app with full scrobbling support.
author: Otix

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jellyfin_library_item_server ON jellyfin_library (item_id, server_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jellyfin_library_tmdb_media ON jellyfin_library (tmdb_id, media_type)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jellyfin_library_server ON jellyfin_library (server_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jellyfin_sync_log_started ON jellyfin_sync_log (started_at)

serverUrl.label: Jellyfin Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of your Jellyfin server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8096

authMode.label: Authentication Mode
authMode.description: Choose between User Credentials or an API Key.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Server API key generated from Jellyfin Dashboard -> Advanced -> API Keys.

syncMovieLibraries.label: Sync movie libraries
syncMovieLibraries.description: Import movies from your Jellyfin movie libraries into the local catalog.

syncShowLibraries.label: Sync TV show libraries
syncShowLibraries.description: Import TV shows from your Jellyfin show libraries into the local catalog.

pollIntervalMinutes.label: Auto-sync interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to re-sync your Jellyfin libraries. 0 disables automatic syncing.
